title: sst5 output schema
description: Single-label fine-grained sentiment (5-point ordinal scale). Metric: accuracy.

label.description: Sentiment degree of a movie-review sentence, ordered terrible<...<great.

labelDefinitions.terrible: Strongly negative — harsh condemnation, no redeeming notes.
labelDefinitions.bad: Mildly negative — disappointed, weak, but not scathing.
labelDefinitions.okay: Neutral or mixed — balanced, lukewarm, or noncommittal.
